meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: Claude 会把代码审查评论压成一行式:每条只写位置、问题、修复,可加 🔴/🟡/🔵/❓ 严重性前缀。遇到安全漏洞、架构分歧或新手作者时,则改用普通段落解释缘由。它只输出可直接粘贴到 PR 的评论,不写修复代码、不做审批,也不跑 linter。
howto.when: 当用户说「review this PR」「code review」「review the diff」等审查请求,或调用 /caveman-review 时触发;审查 pull request 时也会自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审查这个 PR。
say.note: 输出每行一条的压缩评论。

say.text: 把这个 diff 按 caveman-review 风格 review 一下。
say.note: 每条包含位置、问题、修复。

say.text: 切换成 caveman-review 模式,检查这次代码改动。
say.note: 评论会带严重性前缀,可直接粘贴。

howto.what_en: Claude writes one-line review comments: location, problem, fix, with optional severity prefix. For security, architectural, or new-author cases, it uses a normal paragraph. Only outputs paste-ready PR comments; does not write fixes, approve, or lint.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", or invokes /caveman-review; also auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

say_en.text: Review this diff in caveman-review style.
say_en.note: Each comment has location, problem, fix.

say_en.text: Switch to caveman-review mode for this change.
say_en.note: Comments come with severity prefixes, paste-ready.
